name: Seamless tiling (circular conv padding)
plain: Makes image borders wrap so output tiles seamlessly by altering every Conv2d's padding to be circular on the chosen axes. The DiT variant instead rolls the latent by a per-step offset during sampling, and makes the VAE decoder circular.
math: F.pad(x, paddingX, mode=X); F.pad(…,Y); conv with no built-in padding.

props.hook: Direct layer._conv_forward replacement on all Conv2d in model.modules()
props.architectures: UNet Conv2d; DiT tile nodes in OliverCrosby not read

label: from code
surprise: Even its 'clone' option mutates shared layers, since clone() shares .model, so tiling stays on until reset for every wire using the checkpoint.

audit.note: No 'rope' in any provider's .py files. OliverCrosby seamless_dit.py:10-15 rolls the latent by a per-step offset through a UNet wrapper and adds a circular VAE (Conv2d and Conv3d). The 'circular rope' wording is unsupported.
